```yaml
name: Replace [new] with [[alloc] init] in ObjC

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  replace-new:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Replace [new] with [[alloc] init]
        id: replace
        run: |
          # Find and replace in all ObjC source files
          perl -0777 -i -pe 's/\[([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\s+new\]/[[\1 alloc] init]/g' $(git ls-files '*.m' '*.h' '*.mm')
          # Set output if any changes were made
          git diff --quiet || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Commit changes
        if: steps.replace.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          author_name: github-actions[bot]
          author_email: github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com
          message: "chore: replace [new] with [[alloc] init] in ObjC files"
          add: .
          push: true
          default_author: github_actor
```
